marcadores.explicacao_original: Acinar cells are the source of the watery component of saliva, which contains a number of enzymes and electrolytes. Acinar cell cytoplasm is filled with well-defined secretory (zymogen) granules and the nucleus is generally circular or oval-shaped. The watery secretion does not require a wide lumen for release.
